Meaning: Among those whose names are in the above list, from the first creature of the universe, Brahmaji, to Shivji,
Vishnu, Narad, and other powerful deities, humans, superhumans, sages, saints, and uniquely powerful and
prosperous lower beings, including ghosts, devils, spirits, jinns, aquatic creatures, birds, and animals, all these
appear as God, but in reality, none of them are God. In each of these, there remains only a part of God's
great power. Ignorant people are amazed by the astonishing works of material events,
just as tribals are amazed by thunderbolts, huge banyan trees, or seeing a towering mountain in the forest.
They are amazed by seeing a towering mountain. For such underdeveloped humans, even a mere display of God's power is captivating. Beyond this, civilized humans are fascinated by the power of gods and goddesses.

are fascinated by the amazing actions and reactions of natural phenomena, therefore they are also Shakta

when God descends on earth or anywhere within the universe, then ignorant people also
make the mistake of considering them as their own, and in this way they consider Brahma as formless or without attributes. Man should try to know the truth about God, while following the teachings of Brahmaji.
